description:
Power, speed, and fun—for everyone.

The SM21 delivers the perfect blend of performance and versatility at an unbeatable price. Designed for riders of all ages, this lightweight electric dirt bike makes every ride smooth, fast, and easy to handle. Whether you’re a beginner looking to hit the trails or an experienced rider chasing speed, the SM21 adapts to your style.

Powered by a 3kW peak motor and a 48V 23Ah battery, it reaches speeds up to 38 mph with a range of 35 miles on a single charge. The hydraulic front forks and adjustable rear nitrogen shock provide a comfortable, controlled ride across any terrain.

Built with a durable steel frame and hydraulic brakes, the SM21 offers dependable performance without the noise, gas, or maintenance of traditional bikes. With a 6–8 hour charge time and easy handling at just 60kg, it’s perfect for both everyday fun and weekend adventures.

The SM21 — built for speed, comfort, and riders of every age.
